about: The organization's structure in one file. Change it only through CORE-2: write a proposal, ask the founder with the proposal's ID, record the reply, then edit, and put the decision's ID in adopted_by. An item counts as part of the organization only when that decision is signed by the founder at close-out; until then it shows as awaiting signature, and items with no such decision show as proposals.

presets.about: Presets are named shortcuts the founder may start from. They are not levels: any combination of modules is valid, and the founder may change any module at any time through CORE-2. The record-keeping core (AGENTS.md, CORE-4 and CORE-5) is the same under every preset.

roles.title: Founder
roles.purpose: Sets the goal, holds the decision rights the organization reserves to people, signs decisions at close-out, and signs the organization's work.

trigger.when: whenever the founder opens a session or is handed a decision

roles.output: decisions in records/decisions.jsonl; signatures at close-out; signed work in work/

roles.title: Member
roles.purpose: Works with the founder toward the goal; proposes structure; follows the rules in force.

roles.title: Drill
roles.purpose: Tests the organization's checks with a fault the founder plants, so that a check that has quietly stopped working is noticed.

trigger.when: every 3 sessions: the founder plants a sealed drill with python scripts/fos_drill.py plant, and reveals it once the work has been checked

decision_rights.about: Who may decide what. The core reserves all structural decisions to the founder, and only the founder signs decisions at close-out. The decision-rights module lets the founder delegate some decisions, with limits; delegated decisions are signed by the founder like any other.
reserved_to_founder: adopt, change or remove any structure: modules, roles, role instances, models in slots, rules, checks, tools, the view
send, publish or share anything outside the folder

settings.rule_reasons_about: shown = rules are read with their reasons (the default). hidden = rules are compiled without reasons. Hidden exists only for studies that compare the two; change it only through CORE-2.
settings.default_expected_about: Used for any role that does not state expected_every_sessions. A role not run within its expected interval is listed in the role roll-call at session start.
